purpose: Minimum provenance required to claim a modeling run is reproducible. Existing multi-species results do not meet this bar.

git_commit_of_fit.description: Full git commit SHA of the repository state used to fit and score.

random_seed.description: Explicit integer seed(s) for any stochastic procedure; document if deterministic with seed N/A.

environment_lock.description: Pinned environment artifact path (lockfile) plus Python version.

artifact_hash.description: Content hash of primary outputs (e.g. MODEL_RESULTS.csv and any model weights).
